test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Meera made a profit of 5% by selling a bag after offering a discount of 10%. If the marked price of bag is Rs. 1,050, find its cost price.
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the bag = Rs. 1,050

Discount offered = 10%

Profit made = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) - Discount

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price / (1 + Profit%)

**Calculation:**

Discount = 10% of Marked Price

Discount = 10% of Rs. 1,050

Discount = Rs. 105

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price - Discount

SP = Rs. 1,050 - Rs. 105

SP = Rs. 945

Profit% = 5% = 5/100 = 0.05

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + 0.05)

⇒ CP = Rs. 945 / 1.05

⇒ CP = Rs. 900

**The cost price of the bag is Rs. 900.**
